purpose: Give ParkPulse agents a broad operating doctrine of policy-gated, executable amusement-park cases instead of narrow scripted responses.

decision_rules.name: Case-First Action Selection
decision_rules.condition: An operator asks for a solution, plan, mitigation, optimization, or action.
decision_rules.allowed_action: Retrieve the closest actionable case, compare candidate actions, cite policy refs, and prepare receiver-specific payloads.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Jump directly from text intent to a generic reroute or staffing action without a matching case and policy basis.
human_review_if: case affects safety, medical, security, accessibility, emergency access, labor protection, or broad guest movement

decision_rules.name: Receiver-Specific Execution
decision_rules.condition: A plan produces worker, guest, equipment, queue, route, food, or management instructions.
decision_rules.allowed_action: Split the plan into receiver payloads with owner, target, instruction, deadline, evidence, and acknowledgement requirement.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Produce a single vague instruction such as 'fix the queue' or 'send staff' without receiver routing.
human_review_if: manager approval is required by another policy

decision_rules.name: Rollback and Evaluation Required
decision_rules.condition: Any agent action changes routing, staffing, queue gates, guest messaging, or equipment settings.
decision_rules.allowed_action: Define expected impact, observation window, success metric, rollback trigger, and audit trace before execution.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Dispatch without a measurable evaluation window or rollback trigger.

action_cases.title: Ride down while parade releases nearby
action_plan: Hold new intake at the affected ride queue gate.
Split affected guests across two or more compatible destinations with caps.
Keep parade and emergency crossings clear.
Draft guest-facing guidance with honest wait context and nearby alternatives.
blocked_actions: route all guests to one attraction

receiver_payloads.instruction: Hold intake and split exiting guests by destination cap.
Explain ride downtime and offer capped alternatives.
Highlight protected crossing and spillback boundary.

action_cases.success_metric: Affected queue guests and path congestion fall within 15 minutes without raising destination density above 90%.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Any destination exceeds 90% density or parade crossing congestion increases.

action_cases.title: Food court backlog during heat pressure
action_plan: Throttle promotions that increase the overloaded food location.
Redirect demand to lower-wait food points and water refill locations.
Redeploy only trained food runners without violating protected breaks.
Message affected guests with pickup ETA and alternatives.
blocked_actions: send all guests to one alternate food point

receiver_payloads.instruction: Add runner support if certification and break rules allow.

action_cases.success_metric: Pickup ETA and complaint rate improve inside 20 minutes.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Alternate location density or pickup ETA worsens.

action_cases.title: Front gate exit pressure before fireworks release
action_plan: Pre-stage crowd leads before the finale release.
Meter front-gate egress while keeping emergency and accessibility routes open.
Send transit, locker, and alternate-exit guidance before the crowd moves.
Hold last-ride promotions away from exit-pressure paths.
blocked_actions: push promotions toward the exit path

receiver_payloads.instruction: Meter outbound flow and keep access lane open.
Send transit and alternate route guidance before release.

action_cases.success_metric: Exit path density peaks below critical threshold during release.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Access lane becomes blocked or exit density rises above threshold.

action_cases.title: Staff break wave creates unsafe coverage
action_plan: Identify certified backup staff before changing any ride operation.
Protect legally or policy-protected breaks.
Temporarily taper intake where coverage is below requirement.
Notify affected operators and managers with acknowledgement required.
blocked_actions: operate a ride below certification coverage

receiver_payloads.instruction: Approve certified redeploy or intake taper.
Confirm coverage before continuing normal intake.

action_cases.success_metric: Coverage gap closes without protected break violation.
action_cases.rollback_condition: No certified coverage acknowledges the redeploy.

action_cases.title: Fast Lane fairness complaint rising
action_plan: Cap merge ratio until standby delay returns within fairness threshold.
Publish honest standby delay reason without blaming guests.
Offer lower-wait alternatives without individualized compensation promises.
Send guest-care lead to the merge point for explanation.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Apply approved merge cap and explain lane split.
Give honest delay reason and alternatives.

action_cases.success_metric: Standby delay delta and complaint risk decline inside the observation window.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Fast Lane conflict escalates or standby density remains critical.

action_cases.title: Missing child reported near food court
action_plan: Escalate to trained security and guest-care leads without broadcasting child-identifying details.
Create a controlled search perimeter around the reported food court zone.
Route crowd leads to keep exits, service lanes, and family reunification points clear.
Send only privacy-safe staff instructions through approved worker channels.
blocked_actions: send public guest alert with identifying details

receiver_payloads.instruction: Approve lost-child protocol and controlled search perimeter.
Hold exits/service lane clear and route guests around the search perimeter.

action_cases.success_metric: Security/guest-care acknowledgement received and food court search perimeter established without exposing child identity.
action_cases.rollback_condition: No security acknowledgement, exit path blocked, or identifying details appear in guest-facing channels.

action_cases.title: Medical or accessibility access path is blocked
action_plan: Escalate to trained medical/security operations without diagnosis.
Clear and protect the access path.
Route nearby guests around the service lane.
Keep guest details private and only visible to the approved response team.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Approve care/support routing and access protection.
Open and hold the access lane.

action_cases.success_metric: Access route is clear and response team acknowledges inside target time.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Access path remains blocked or crowd density increases near the incident.
